name: gptplease
description: Send requests and files to ChatGPT Chat or Work with purpose-appropriate model and reasoning selection, then return the completed response.

interface.shortDescription: 목적별 Chat·Work 모델 선택, 파일 첨부와 응답 회수
interface.longDescription: Use $gptplease for requested ChatGPT consultation. Select model and reasoning from live Chat or Work options based on purpose, complexity, consequences, and time/cost limits. Preserve explicit settings, including Chat Pro or Astra Pro. Work is the unspecified new-request surface default. Verify settings and attachments before one UI submission, wait for completion, and process the full response here. Requires supported browser control and login.
defaultPrompt: Use $gptplease to review my selected files in Chat with suitable model and reasoning, then check the response here.
Use $gptplease in Work with model and reasoning suited to this task, then bring the complete response back here.
